test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 27 Jan 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Parts of the following sentence have been given as options. One of them may contain an error. Select the part that contains the error from the given options. If you don't find any error, mark 'No error' as your answer.**

Rover had eaten the pie before we gets home.
solution:
The correct answer is: **We gets home**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The verb "**gets**" is incorrect because it should be in the past tense to match the rest of the sentence.
 
• The correct verb should be "**got**" to match the past tense of "**had eaten**."
 
• The correct sentence should be "*Rover had eaten the pie before we got home.*"

Thus, **option 1** is the correct answer.
